subject.title: [Feature]:Add configUrl and configButton support in SKILL.md frontmatter

question: Should the Web Dashboard expose skill-authored configuration actions from `SKILL.md` metadata, and what URL/action trust contract should govern them?
rationale: The code path is identifiable, but accepting arbitrary skill-provided configuration links changes public skill metadata and dashboard trust semantics.

options.title: Approve typed config action
options.body: Add a generic configuration action with explicit URL validation, trust labeling, API/docs coverage, and dashboard rendering.

options.title: Use existing link surfaces
options.body: Keep `homepage`, Skill Card, and ClawHub pages as the supported configuration discovery path without new frontmatter fields.

options.title: Prototype in ClawHub first
options.body: Let ClawHub or Skill Card metadata carry configuration links before promoting a core dashboard action contract.

recommendation.title: Approve typed config action
recommendation.body: Add a generic configuration action with explicit URL validation, trust labeling, API/docs coverage, and dashboard rendering.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice centers on the dashboard URL trust boundary that history ties to shakkernerd’s URL-helper work.
